fit.notice: Irregular observations fit directly; no arbitrary requirement that every historic month be almost complete. Rank/conditioning and coverage retained. Test availability gate unchanged.

candidates.trend_estimator: TheilSen annual mean residuals; slope shrinkage, latest-year intercept correction. No test-level update.

selection: Fixed two rolling-origin years; objective mean quarter MAE+0.25*worst-quarter MAE. Complexity must improve objective>=0.001m and no quarter may regress more than0.005m in development. This development rule does not relax any test gate. Baseline is independently CV-selected8/20constant astronomical model.

interval.calibration: maximum per-quarter absolute-error quantile over two disjoint calibration years, plus annual-bias spread; never clip width after test
interval.notice: Empirical interannual envelope, not a future surge forecast or formal coverage guarantee.

short.selection: 2025NOAA/previousUHSLC odd months development; no new annual2025station short model
short.interval: fixed preceding-year radius plus causal past14day residual quantile, matured no later than forecast input cutoff

independence: Six new UHSLC stations: no2025test truth fetched until all coefficients/intervals/source hashes freeze. Prior station metadata only is allowed.
NOAA8+previousUHSLC8 July9..31are genuinely new periods. July1..8is short-horizon context only; no July observations initialize or update long-open-loop forecasts.
All previous V2..V6results and failures immutable. Any rescore on a previously viewed cohort is diagnostic, never new independent validation.
Archive event time does not establish as-published timing or local sensor access. FD/RQ and local datums kept distinct. Missing truth remains missing and in test denominators.
